Name: Butch Leah Spouse Portrait
Author: ribeooo
Description:
First mod! This would've taken me an hour max if it didn't take me ages to figure out the right coordinates and rechecking Content Patcher's documentation lol

I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38052]Butch Leah Additions[/url] by Morgansmallhead, however her spouse portrait stayed the same so I took matters into my own hands!

That mod isn't required, however. This mod can be used on its own, and only requires Content Patcher.

Downloads.Description: See changelogs. Don't be alarmed by the file size change lol

Manifest.Name: Butch Leah Spouse Portrait
Manifest.Description: Retextures Leah's spouse portrait to match with Morgansmallhead's Butch Leah Additions.
Manifest.Author: ribeooo
